title: runtime: carry the caller-scope record-load signal into a flow action's context — dispatchFlowAction spreads actionRecordLoadSignal on both doors (the runtime half of #14244)
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` PM seat (session `session_0174WZTU6XcFcS7g2kykC53i`, seat post #6017) at 2026-09-04T04:37Z as the **runtime half** of #14244, whose contract half landed in PR #15143 (merge `63cd4877`, 04:33Z): `AutomationContext.recordLoadDenied?: true` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts:63`), the flow face of the handler-face signal #14143 introduced. Cross-lane request into the `domain:cli` lane (`packages/runtime`); `domain:*` is triage's to set. Provenance: the #14244 dev's read-and-report (PR #15143 body), the seat's contract review (PR #15143 comment 5535204682), the seat's re-read of `origin/main` `25a59bd10` at 04:36Z.

## Measured on `origin/main` `25a59bd10` (04:36Z)

- **Producer**: `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:1278` — `actionRecordLoadSignal(load): { recordLoadDenied?: true }`, built from `loadActionSubjectRecord` (`:1245-1270`).
- **Script-body door, both call sites already carry it**: the MCP `run_action` path spreads `...actionRecordLoadSignal(subject)` into `actionContext` beside `record` (`action-execution.ts:1435`); the REST actions route does the same (`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts:657`).
- **Flow door, neither call site carries it**: `dispatchFlowAction` (`action-execution.ts:791`) takes `wiring: { objectName, record, params, recordId, ec, envId }` — no subject, no signal — and builds the flow's context from `record`, `userId: ec?.userId` and `seedFlowActionParams(...)` only. Its two callers, `action-execution.ts:1407` (MCP) and `domains/actions.ts:685` (REST), pass the same six keys. So a flow started on a row the caller cannot read sees a stamped `record.id` and nothing else — the contract now declares the key the engine never receives.
- The contract's TSDoc carries a sentence stating the key is NOT YET POPULATED on the flow face; the pin `automation-context-record-load-denied.pin.test.ts` names it (the PR #15143 review: retire the sentence in the same stroke that populates the key).

## The ask (`packages/runtime`)

1. `dispatchFlowAction`'s wiring gains the load signal (pass `subject`, or the already-computed `actionRecordLoadSignal(subject)` object), and the flow context spreads it as a **sibling key of `record`** — never onto `record`, never `false`: absent when nothing was refused, exactly the producer's shape and the contract's `true | undefined`.
2. Both doors in the same stroke: `action-execution.ts:1407` and `domains/actions.ts:685`.
3. Pins: a flow started on an unreadable row sees `ctx.recordLoadDenied === true`; a readable one sees the key absent (not `false`); the REST and MCP doors agree.
4. Retire the contract's "NOT YET POPULATED" sentence in `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts` and adjust the pin that names it — the one `packages/spec` edit pre-authorised for this card by the spec seat (recorded here and on #14244); anything else under `packages/spec` comes back to the spec lane.

Context-only first: this card populates the key; whether the automation engine acts on it (a flow-level refusal, a step condition) is a separate reading, not part of this card.
